title: vast-h3 provisioning config
description: Schema for config.json consumed by default.sh. Each field maps to a specific behavior in the provisioning pipeline. See README.md for the runtime flow.

$schema.description: URI of this schema file. Standard JSON Schema reference; ignored by default.sh at runtime. Set to './config.schema.json' for local files, or the raw.githubusercontent.com URL when fetching config.json from a remote.

schema_version.description: Integer version of the config schema this document conforms to. Bump on breaking changes; default.sh can refuse to load a config with a higher version than it knows about.

comfyui.description: Optional metadata describing the ComfyUI base image and how it should be launched. Documentation only — the launch flags and dir are read from environment variables at runtime (COMFYUI_DIR, COMFYUI_ARGS), not from this block.

image.description: Vast base image tag. Reference only; not pulled by default.sh.

dir.description: Where ComfyUI is installed. Set COMFYUI_DIR env var to override (default: /workspace/ComfyUI).

port.description: Port the ComfyUI web UI listens on. Reference only.

launch_args.description: COMFYUI_ARGS passed to the base-image supervisor. Must include --lowvram for VRAM < 32GB (preflight forces this automatically).

huggingface.description: Per-engine download settings for Hugging Face models. Each entry sets env vars for one HF download engine. Models reference an engine by name (see models[].engine).

engine.description: Which HF download engine this entry configures. Models point to this name via models[].engine.

settings.description: Engine-specific knobs. Keys depend on engine: xet understands high_performance and concurrent_range_gets; hf_hub has no settings.

high_performance.description: (xet) Set HF_XET_HIGH_PERFORMANCE=1 — skips Xet's adaptive ramp-up, locks to peak concurrency immediately.

concurrent_range_gets.description: (xet) HF_XET_NUM_CONCURRENT_RANGE_GETS — parallel HTTP range fetches per file. 64 is a sane default for a 1 Gbit pipe; raise on faster links.

models.description: Models to download. Each entry is dispatched to the provider matching its source field (providers/<source>.sh). All four sources are listed below; use one per entry.

oneOf.description: Hugging Face model pulled from a repo. Choose engine 'xet' (default, fastest, ~600 MB/s) or 'hf_hub' (sequential, resumable, works on private/gated).

repo.description: Hugging Face repo id, e.g. 'Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3' or 'private-org/private-repo'.

files.description: Files within the repo to download. Paths are relative to the repo root. Spaces and most shell metacharacters are fine; quote if in doubt.

engine.description: Which HF download engine to use. 'xet' is the default and is what you want unless the repo is private/gated and xet returns 401 (then 'hf_hub').

oneOf.description: CivitAI checkpoint. Downloaded via aria2c with 'Authorization: Bearer ${CIVITAI_TOKEN}' (must be set in Vast env).

url.description: CivitAI download URL (the resolved one from the model page, not the page URL).

path.description: Destination path under ${COMFYUI_DIR}/models/. Subdirectory is preserved (e.g. 'checkpoints/foo.safetensors' -> models/checkpoints/foo.safetensors).

oneOf.description: Plain HTTP/HTTPS URL. Downloaded via aria2c with no auth header.

url.description: Direct download URL. aria2c with 16 connections, 16 splits, 8M min block.

modules.description: Custom nodes / plugins to install via git clone. Each entry is cloned into ${COMFYUI_DIR}/custom_nodes/ and pip-installed if it has a requirements.txt.

url.description: Git URL. Use 'url@branch' shorthand (e.g. 'https://github.com/x/y@dev') OR pair with the 'branch' field.

branch.description: Git branch/tag to check out. Optional — defaults to the repo's default branch. May contain env-var-style defaults like '${SPEED_BRANCH:-main}' which are evaluated at clone time.

env.description: Extra env vars to export before any download. Keys are variable names; values are strings. Existing env (HF_TOKEN, CIVITAI_TOKEN, etc.) is NOT overridden by this block — set those in the Vast UI instead.
